fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: A thrown jaw that deals 22 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It only strikes a target at or below 25% of its health.

fusions.name: Set Scent
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds, so your abilities bite deeper. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Lie in Wait
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Trapline Hound
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded hound that fights beside you, striking for 5 damage. It also makes its target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
